text:
alice.k: Starting regional rollout for 2026.1.4 — US/EU/APAC. Doing slice-based ramp. Quick capacity check before we go live.
ben: On it. what are target percentages?
alice.k: US 30% -> 60% over next 45m, EU 10% -> 50%, APAC hold at 0% until backfill confirmed.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026.1.4: started canary -> US slice 10% @ 5115001240. Canary image: rwd-2026.1.4. Pinned fallback: rwd-2026.1.3
cheng: US infra looks fine: reserved gpu pool 120, current used 75 (62%). headroom ok for 60% traffic.
dana: APAC warm pool only 6 instances, expected to hit 85% GPU util if we ramp. Recommend soft-pin APAC to 2026.1.3 and backfill overnight.
alice.k: I like soft-pin. ben, can you hold APAC and keep EU rolling to 25%?
ben: Yep holding APAC. ramping EU to 25% now.
deploy-bot: US 20% -> 30% scheduled in 10m. EU increased to 25% at 5115001255.
cheng: running smoke tests against EU cluster now:
```
curl -sS https://eu.api.redwood-inference.internal/health | jq .
{"ok":true,"latency_ms":120}
```
dana: Will open a backfill ticket for APAC (BKF-4872) and attach node procurement ETA.
ben: added rollback triggers to the rollout doc: error_rate > 1.5% over 5m OR p95 latency > 800ms -> immediate rollback and notification.
alice.k: noted. also added a temporary route pin in the console for APAC -> rwd-2026.1.3 :lock: 
oncall-bot: alert suppressed for deploy window between 02:00-06:00 UTC (maintenance window).
alice.k: Decision: proceed — US -> continue to 60% over 45m, EU -> 50% over 30m, APAC -> soft-pin + backfill overnight. If any rollback trigger fires we revert to rwd-2026.1.3 and open incident channel.
ben: copying release notes here: https://redwood.corp/releases/2026.1.4 (summary + known issues)
cheng: will monitor token latency and kv cache hit rates, posting perf graphs in 15m.
dana: ticket BKF-4872 created, linking infra lead @inha. ETA nodes by tomorrow 09:00 PST.
alice.k: thanks all. tagging @ops-handoff for overnight tracking. :white_check_mark:
